name: AIGCBench
intro: AIGCBench 是面向图生视频生成的综合评测，结合真实视频-文本、真实图像-文本和经文本组合、GPT-4扩写及SDXL生成筛选得到的数据，共3,928个测试样本，并以4个维度下的11项指标和人工研究验证评测标准。
org: Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 真实数据采样, 文本组合, GPT-4扩写, SDXL生成与筛选
eval_feature: 控制-视频对齐, 运动效果, 时序一致性, 视频质量, 人工验证
build_method_en: Real-data sampling, text combination, GPT-4 enrichment, SDXL generation and filtering
eval_feature_en: Control-video alignment, motion effects, temporal consistency, video quality, human validation
intro_en: AIGCBench is a comprehensive image-to-video benchmark combining real video-text pairs, real image-text pairs, and generated image-text data built with a text combiner, GPT-4 enrichment, and filtered SDXL images. It contains 3,928 test cases and validates 11 metrics across four dimensions with a user study.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2401.01651v3 Sections 3-5.3 and BenchCouncil/AIGCBench@cc230c8474fdd1af8a7a0749981aa1d09198eaf3. WebVid validation contributes 1,000 subtype-aware video-text pairs, while the paper describes 925 LAION-Aesthetics samples as random and the fixed README calls them curated. CivitAI high-frequency terms seed 3,000 composed prompts; GPT-4 enriches them with the exact Make Content More Vivid and Rich instruction; SDXL xl-base renders 1,280×720 images, and T2I-CompBench filtering retains the top 2,003, for 3,928 cases. Pika contributes only 60 generated videos: 30 WebVid-derived and 30 generated-image-derived. Metric applicability is split between image-text and video-text sources; the paper uses four reference keyframes while repository code defaults to five. The paper reports 11 unique metrics across four dimensions, but Flow and DOVER implementations are absent from the fixed repository. The 42-person study records a best-method vote without claiming independent ratings, and metric-human alignment is qualitative because no correlation statistic is reported.
